title: International driving permit (IDP) – Terms and Conditions
summary: This page outlines the terms and conditions for obtaining and using an International Driving Permit (IDP) from Service NSW.
who_can_apply: The IDP is for use when driving outside of Australia.

faqs.q: What is the purpose of the International Driving Permit (IDP)?
faqs.a: The IDP is a document that helps you drive legally when you are outside of Australia.

faqs.q: Who is responsible for ensuring I drive legally?
faqs.a: You are responsible for ensuring that you drive legally at all times, including having the correct documentation.

faqs.q: What happens if I misuse the IDP?
faqs.a: Misuse of the IDP can lead to suspension or termination of the permit.
